followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the observed Kasumbalesa ordinary-trader denial into Zambia, distinct from the Congolese national GL06 policy and later pedestrian phases. The contemporary refusal is direct enough for the scoped inclusion. Retain DRC-to-Zambia small traders and Zambia-side authority as attributed by Actualite.cd. Freight exemptions, truck-crew procedures and separately imposed Congolese measures are not merged into a blanket cargo closure. Retain the 27 March 2020 observation with unknown onset and endpoint under withheld_observation_only. Later March 28 descriptions conflict with the earlier observation; April 1 freight return does not end the trader phase. Later Congolese pedestrian evidence does not prove continuous Zambia-side denial. Retain Health and biosecurity / Human disease control as the explicit attributed Zambian reason. No written Zambian order was retrieved, and no trade or political motive is inferred. Actualite.cd supplies trader denial; Radio Okapi separately supplies Congolese exceptions and observed freight return; Adiac preserves conflicting onset wording. Different articles do not automatically constitute independent observation of the same cohort. Retain unlocated Kasumbalesa text and null coordinates. Formal post entry, informal routes and later Congolese corridor measures are not treated as identical physical locations or enforcement episodes.
